lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਦਰਸਨ ਘਣੀ ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan piaas darasan ghanee koee aan milaavai maai ||
lines.translation: My mind and body are so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Won't someone please come and lead me to him, O my mother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t sahaaee prem ke hau tin kai laagaa paai ||
lines.translation: The Saints are the helpers of the Lord's lovers; I fall and touch their feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin prabh kiu sukh paaeeai doojee naahee jaai ||
lines.translation: Without God, how can I find peace? There is nowhere else to go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿੰਨੑੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ji(n)nhee chaakhiaa prem ras se tripat rahe aaghaai ||
lines.translation: Those who have tasted the sublime essence of His Love, remain satisfied and fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap tiaag binatee karahi lehu prabhoo laR laai ||
lines.translation: They renounce their selfishness and conceit, and they pray, "God, please attach me to the hem of Your robe."

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਆ ਸਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo har ka(n)t milaaeeaa s vichhuR katahi na jaai ||
lines.translation: Those whom the Husband Lord has united with Himself, shall not be separated from Him again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਿਣੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh vin doojaa ko nahee naanak har saranaai ||
lines.translation: Without God, there is no other at all. Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸੂ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਸੰਦੀਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: asoo sukhee vasa(n)deeaa jinaa maiaa har raai ||8||
lines.translation: In Assu, the Lord, the Sovereign King, has granted His Mercy, and they dwell in peace. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਤਿਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: katik karam kamaavane dos na kaahoo jog ||
lines.translation: In the month of Katak, do good deeds. Do not try to blame anyone else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਤੇ ਭੁਲਿਆਂ ਵਿਆਪਨਿ ਸਭੇ ਰੋਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: paramesar te bhuliaa(n) viaapan sabhe rog ||
lines.translation: Forgetting the Transcendent Lord, all sorts of illnesses are contracted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੇਮੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਲਗਨਿ ਜਨਮ ਵਿਜੋਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: vemukh hoe raam te lagan janam vijog ||
lines.translation: Those who turn their backs on the Lord shall be separated from Him and consigned to reincarnation, over and over again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਉੜੇ ਹੋਇ ਗਏ ਜਿਤੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਭੋਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin mahi kauRe hoi gae jitaRe maaiaa bhog ||
lines.translation: In an instant, all of Maya's sensual pleasures turn bitter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੈ ਕਿਸ ਥੈ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਰੋਜ ॥
lines.transliteration: vich na koee kar sakai kis thai rovahi roj ||
lines.translation: No one can then serve as your intermediary. Unto whom can we turn and cry?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: keetaa kichhoo na hovaee likhiaa dhur sa(n)jog ||
lines.translation: By one's own actions, nothing can be done; destiny was pre-determined from the very beginning.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਓਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee meraa prabh milai taa(n) utarahi sabh biog ||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, I meet my God, and then all pain of separation departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਬੰਦੀ ਮੋਚ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kau prabh raakh lehi mere saahib ba(n)dee moch ||
lines.translation: Please protect Nanak, God; O my Lord and Master, please release me from bondage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਤਿਕ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਸਭੇ ਸੋਚ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: katik hovai saadhasa(n)g binasahi sabhe soch ||9||
lines.translation: In Katak, in the Company of the Holy, all anxiety vanishes. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਘਿਰਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਸੋਹੰਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਠੜੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)ghir maahi soha(n)deeaa har pir sa(n)g baithaReeaah ||
lines.translation: In the month of Maghar, those who sit with their Beloved Husband Lord are beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਿ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਮੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee sobhaa kiaa ganee j saahib melaReeaah ||
lines.translation: How can their glory be measured? Their Lord and Master blends them with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man mauliaa raam siu sa(n)g saadh sahelaReeaah ||
lines.translation: Their bodies and minds blossom forth in the Lord; they have the companionship of the Holy Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਸੇ ਰਹਨਿ ਇਕੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadh janaa te baaharee se rahan ikelaReeaah ||
lines.translation: Those who lack the Company of the Holy, remain all alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਉਤਰੈ ਸੇ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਪੜੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin dukh na kabahoo utarai se jam kai vas paReeaah ||
lines.translation: Their pain never departs, and they fall into the grip of the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਖੜੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee raaviaa prabh aapanaa se disan nit khaReeaah ||
lines.translation: Those who have ravished and enjoyed their God, are seen to be continually exalted and uplifted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਜੜੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: ratan javehar laal har ka(n)th tinaa jaReeaah ||
lines.translation: They wear the Necklace of the jewels, emeralds and rubies of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣੀ ਦਰਿ ਪੜੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak baa(n)chhai dhooR tin prabh saranee dar paReeaah ||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the dust of the feet of those who take to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਘਿਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧਣਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਨਮੜੀਆਹ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)ghir prabh aaraadhanaa bahuR na janamaReeaah ||10||
lines.translation: Those who worship and adore God in Maghar, do not suffer the cycle of reincarnation ever again. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੋਖਿ ਤੁਖਾਰੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਕੰਠਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pokh tukhaar na viaapaee ka(n)th miliaa har naahu ||
lines.translation: In the month of Poh, the cold does not touch those, whom the Husband Lord hugs close in His Embrace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਚਰਨਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਲਗੜਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man bedhiaa charanaarabi(n)d darasan lagaRaa saahu ||
lines.translation: Their minds are transfixed by His Lotus Feet. They are attached to the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਟ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ot govi(n)d gopaal raai sevaa suaamee laahu ||
lines.translation: Seek the Protection of the Lord of the Universe; His service is truly profitable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikhiaa pohi na sakaee mil saadhoo gun gaahu ||
lines.translation: Corruption shall not touch you, when you join the Holy Saints and sing the Lord's Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ ਤਹ ਮਿਲੀ ਸਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਮਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah te upajee tah milee sachee preet samaahu ||
lines.translation: From where it originated, there the soul is blended again. It is absorbed in the Love of the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੀਆਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar gahi leenee paarabraham bahuR na vichhuReeaahu ||
lines.translation: When the Supreme Lord God grasps someone's hand, he shall never again suffer separation from Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਲਖ ਬੇਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: baar jaau lakh bereeaa har sajan agam agaahu ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, 100,000 times, to the Lord, my Friend, the Unapproachable and Unfathomable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਮ ਪਈ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਪਈਆਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saram paee naaraainai naanak dar paeeaahu ||
lines.translation: Please preserve my honor, Lord; Nanak begs at Your Door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੋਖੁ ਸੋੁਹੰਦਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: pokh souha(n)daa sarab sukh jis bakhase veparavaahu ||11||
lines.translation: Poh is beautiful, and all comforts come to that one, whom the Carefree Lord has forgiven. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਘਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂਆ ਧੂੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: maagh majan sa(n)g saadhooaa dhooRee kar isanaan ||
lines.translation: In the month of Maagh, let your cleansing bath be the dust of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam dhiaai sun sabhanaa no kar daan ||
lines.translation: Meditate and listen to the Name of the Lord, and give it to everyone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਕਰਮ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam karam mal utarai man te jaai gumaan ||
lines.translation: In this way, the filth of lifetimes of karma shall be removed, and egotistical pride shall vanish from your mind.
